comment: What must not silently disappear from brand-images. `prose` names guardrails no code enforces; `split` declares which half of the skill is deterministic; `baseline` names the offline, $0 checks pinned against a real run.

prose.pattern: Every generation uses the selected versioned brand profile;
prose.rationale: The one rule. It is the reason this skill exists rather than a prompt; lose the line and the skill becomes a generic assistant with extra steps.

prose.pattern: Never claim a result you did not observe
prose.rationale: Honesty about what was verified is the whole house contract. A skill that reports success it did not witness is worse than one that reports nothing.

prose.pattern: never ask about anything in it
prose.rationale: Two questions maximum is only achievable because detection already answered the rest. Asking about a detectable signal is the UX failure that makes a skill feel like a form.

prose.pattern: Silence creates no approval and no style update
prose.rationale: No autonomous mutation of brand from lack of feedback.
Claude and Codex need real image capabilities, not assumed APIs.
Saved preferences cannot be described as retraining.

deterministic.step: Isolate and validate saved profiles and revisions
Compile repeatable briefs with approved references
Persist explicitly scoped feedback and audit changes
Check run receipts and revision consistency

nondeterministic.step: Discover a distinctive visual style from user instructions and references
nondeterministic.why: Visual preferences and reference interpretation require judgment; proposed attributes remain unconfirmed until the user accepts them.

nondeterministic.step: Generate and visually review the actual image
nondeterministic.why: Use an available image generation tool, then inspect palette, medium, lighting, texture, composition and avoid-list against the selected profile. Report drift honestly and use bounded retries.

nondeterministic.step: Interpret feedback as specific proposed profile edits
nondeterministic.why: Distinguish image content from recurring style and ambiguous preferences; ask only when durable intent is unclear.

_baseline_comment: Pinned against a real run of this skill, never a synthetic fixture. Offline and $0 by construction: no network, no model, so CI cannot spend and cannot flake.

baseline.rationale: Pins brief compilation, explicit composition feedback and artifact receipts from the actual two-image mountain run; pixels are frozen evidence, not a CI regeneration.
Replay corrupts the second run’s profile hash and must fail specifically at revision validation; unit tests additionally cover missing references, cross-profile feedback and unconfirmed edits.
